## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 9 sept. 2026 - 9 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Sylthfern_, 9 sept. 2026, 4/5: "I've been a long time user of this app. I really like how easy it is to customize a routine. that the routines can be done anywhere because they don't require weights or equipment, however, that you can add those things if you want to. only recently this app has started to have ads and they're not too intrusive"

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      1 avis récent mentionne bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 11 sept. 2026 - 11 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Jeri_, 11 sept. 2026, 5/5: "This is day 2 for me. I just finished my 3rd workout, & I'm sweating! Time 2 hit the shower! 😂 If u have an issue w/1 of the exercises It wants u 2 do, u can replace it. They have many possibilities for each exercise 2 B replaced with. If u don't like the order that the exercises are in, you can change the order. You can do as many workouts as you want in a day. It's all up to you and how much work you want to put in."
